title: Ceiling logarithm of two
statement: The ceiling of the base-$2$ logarithm of $2$ is $1$.
replaced:
The ceiling of the base-$2$ logarithm of $2$ equals $1$: in Lean's natural-number
ceiling logarithm, $\lceil \log_2 2 \rceil = 1$. This is the numeric fact used to
specialize the additive $\lceil \log_2 \abs{\alpha} \rceil$ overhead to $1$ for
Boolean-valued functions.
